scripts.text:
UPDATE AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG Log
        SET TOTALRECORDS = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AGP.CIRS_AUTHORIZATION_DATA WHERE RUNID = LOG.RUNID)
        WHERE INBOUNDFILENAME = @AuthFileName AND FILETYPE = 'AUTH' AND RUNID = @RUNID

UPDATE AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG LOG 
    SET OutboundFileName = @AuthOBFileName,
             TotalSubsetRecs = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AGP.CIRS_AUTHORIZATION_DATA WHERE RUNID = LOG.RUNID AND TRIM(ERROR_CODE) IS NULL),
             TotalErrorRecs = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AGP.CIRS_AUTHORIZATION_DATA WHERE RUNID = LOG.RUNID AND TRIM(ERROR_CODE) IS NOT NULL),
             Status = 'COMPLETED'
        WHERE  RUNID = @RUNID AND FileType = 'AUTH'

    SET OutboundFileName = @ConfOBFileName,
             TotalSubsetRecs = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AGP.CIRS_CONFIDENTIAL_COMM_DATA WHERE RUNID = LOG.RUNID AND TRIM(ERROR_CODE) IS NULL),
             TotalErrorRecs = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AGP.CIRS_CONFIDENTIAL_COMM_DATA WHERE RUNID = LOG.RUNID AND TRIM(ERROR_CODE) IS NOT NULL),
             Status = 'COMPLETED'
        WHERE  RUNID = @RUNID AND FileType = 'CONF'
